coordinateDirectionOverrides.thumb_CMC_flex: positive q is extension, negative q is flexion
coordinateDirectionOverrides.ring_MCP_abd: positive q is adduction toward the middle finger
coordinateDirectionOverrides.pinky_MCP_abd: positive q is adduction toward the middle finger
coordinateDirectionOverrides.middle_MCP_abd: use radial/ulnar deviation to avoid ambiguous middle-finger abduction

rendering: The public MyoHand surface and tendon paths are a visual reference. The 16-joint/23-DoF ranges and associations are from the SHM OpenSim control table. ROM motion uses prescribed single-joint kinematics with native MyoHand anchors/axes, descendant bone transforms, thumb sign conversion, and approximate tendon-route blending. Thumb MCP lateral motion uses a constructed axis. This is not a SHM-to-MyoHand registration, muscle-force simulation, collision solver, or a claim about native MyoHand moment arms.
attachmentDisplay: attachment-catalog.js labels the displayed MyoHand geometry and equivalent endpoints. route-data.js contains regional visual-only fits; docs/attachment-audit.json records all 74 endpoints. endpoint-data.js retains the separate original SHM body-frame mapping, not the displayed attachment labels.
